# Draft:Vention (software company)

----
Vention is a software development company headquartered in New York City. The firm provides custom engineering and digital product development services  for startups and established enterprises in sectors such as financial technology, health technology, e-commerce, and artificial intelligence.
History
Vention traces its origins to 2002 and has expanded its operations over the course of two decades to include globally distributed development hubs in Eastern Europe and Latin America.
Services
The company's service offerings include custom software engineering, mobile and web application development, quality assurance, cloud architecture, and AI-driven product development. Trade publications have also identified Vention as active in data engineering,  and financial software development.
Research and media coverage
Vention has been cited in mainstream and business media for conducting research related to workforce and technology education trends.
